To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have created an algorithm for banknote recognition and value conversion that is capable of recognizing banknotes with varying degrees of occlusion and that is capable of running on a mobile device.

the proposed banknote recognition algorithm has an average recognition rate of 98% for the 20 banknote images used in our experiments and an average recognition rate for 20 banknote image pairs of 95% when occluded by 10% and 20% of a second banknote.
we have developed a mobile application capable of recognizing foreign currency banknotes in a wide range of conditions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a banknote conversion system that is capable of recognizing multiple banknotes in varying levels of occlusions and converting the value to USD.
the development of an algorithm that can recognize banknotes of varying sizes, orientations, and levels of occlusion.
the development of a mobile system capable for recognizing and converting the value multiple foreign banknotes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this system is a viable solution to the problem of recognizing and converting foreign banknotes.
the banknote recognition algorithm is robust and can be used in the mobile application to detect banknotes with high accuracy.
the proposed system is capable of recognizing foreign banknotes in a wide variety of settings and orientations, and is capable of accurately determining the value of each banknote.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a mobile banknote recognition application that can detect, identify, and convert banknotes from multiple countries.
we developed a banknote recognition and conversion system for mobile devices.
we have successfully developed a system capable of recognizing banknotes from a wide range of angles and scales, and then converting the value of those banknotes into USD.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a system can be built to recognize foreign banknotes with an acceptable degree of accuracy.
we have developed a system capable of recognizing banknotes with varying orientations, scales, occlusions, lighting, and backgrounds.
we have demonstrated that it is possible to build a mobile application that can detect and recognize foreign banknotes in a wide variety of conditions.
